name: Projection Truth
basis: CORRECTED 2026-08-11: G2-01 was published as CRITICAL and is now REFUTED - the field DOES render at the antimeridian; the blank screenshot was a SETTLE-TIME artifact (blank at 10 s, painted by 20 s), not a projection defect. The proposed mechanism was refuted too: __RAW_GPU__.wrapCull reads needWrap=true at 179.6E (vbWest 162.44, vbEast 196.76) and false at the mid-Pacific control, so the world-copy loop (WebGLMarineEngine.js:1850, offsets [0,-360,+360]) engages exactly as designed; WebGLMarineEngine.js:496-502 shows this defect class was already found and fixed. Residual LOW observation G2-01b: antimeridian paint appeared slower than both controls (blank at 10 s vs painted at 10 s elsewhere) - NOT measured head-to-head, must not be reported as a defect until time-to-paint is. PASSING evidence unchanged and independently verified: exact Web Mercator per-vertex transform with correct 85.051129 clamp; mid-cell interpolation error <=0.1 km at 0.25deg and <=3.9 km at 2deg (worst 147.9 km at 10deg/75N is ~13% of a cell); bearing 45 and pitch 45 both preserve max=2.571 exactly; 0 NaN across 7 geographies; zero skipped Jest tests. ORIGINAL SUPERSEDED TEXT: the marine field does not render at/near the antimeridian. Aleutians 179.6E/51.5N z4.2 = NOTHING painted, while mid-Pacific 140W z4.2 and North Atlantic 30W at the SAME 51.5N and SAME z4.2 both render fully - zoom-fade and high-latitude confounds both eliminated by control. Data was present (594 vectors, 447 nonzero, 0 NaN) and coastlines drew correctly across 180. PASSED within the gate: exact Web Mercator per-vertex transform with correct 85.051129 clamp; mid-cell interpolation error <=0.1 km at 0.25deg and <=3.9 km at 2deg (worst 147.9 km at 10deg/75N is ~13% of a cell); bearing 45 and pitch 45 both preserve max=2.571 exactly; 0 NaN across 7 geographies; zero skipped Jest tests. STILL untested: DPR 1v2, resize, pixel-wise OceanMask registration, synthetic canonical fields.
required_corrective_action: Verify whether the marine custom layer emits wrapped world copies (u_lng_offset +/-360); add a deterministic ANTIMERIDIAN HEATMAP render test (the existing antimeridian tests cover the mask and the series bbox, not the painted field); re-run the 3-view control as acceptance

name: Capacity
basis: MEASURED 2026-08-11 against the LOCAL backend (production load-testing prohibited by section 4). PASS on the leak-risk criteria: across a 6-cycle soak canvases=4, mapLayers=143, rafLive=5, intervals=4, progNet=2 were CONSTANT, and texNet/bufNet trended NEGATIVE (more deletes than creates) - no leak on any tracked resource. Heap sawtoothed 131 -> 234.6 -> 144.3 -> 187.9 MB with GC reclaiming, no monotonic ratchet. Cold start 11641 ms to first field, 5 requests, 1.71 MB. Mobile 375x812 DPR2 renders correctly (169 vectors, 0 NaN). CONDITIONS: transfer is spiky - one soak cycle moved +8.79 MB (7x the next largest, the global grid_series signature) and a single mobile resize cost +26.05 MB / +8 requests; session total 79 requests / 39.24 MB for ~3 min of ordinary interaction, which is the axis with the documented Render OOM history. F-C3: GPU particle budget stayed 87616 on mobile while the CPU foam layer scales 2200/1000/500. RETRACTION: frame behaviour is NOT measurable in this harness (RAF delivered 1 frame in 5 s due to unfocused-pane throttling) - the earlier FPS readings of 5/13/18/31 are WITHDRAWN and no frame-performance claim is supported.
required_corrective_action: Measure frame behaviour in a non-throttled harness (focused window or Playwright with visible viewport) before any full PASS; bound the global grid_series transfer spikes; decide whether the GPU particle budget should scale by device and re-measure on a cold mobile boot
